question: What distinct postures are assigned to the right and left feet of the Aśvins?
premises: The right feet are hanging down.
The left legs are in the vaikuṭika seated posture.
The verse distinguishes right and left positions.
inference: The Aśvins are depicted with right feet hanging and left legs in vaikuṭika posture.
uncertainties: The exact technical meaning of vaikuṭikāsana is uncertain.
plain_english: Their right feet hang down, while their left legs are placed in the vaikuṭika posture.
